title: Nick's House of Horrors Trivia: Level 2

questions.question: What is the real name of Angus Scrimm, who played the Tall Man?
questions.fact: He also wrote Grammy-winning liner notes under his real name.

questions.question: What was The Evil Dead's working title during production?
questions.fact: Distributors thought "Book of the Dead" sounded too much like homework.

questions.question: Sam Raimi's yellow car, "The Classic," appears in nearly all his films. What is it?
questions.fact: It even shows up in medieval times in Army of Darkness.

questions.question: In Deep Red, David Hemmings' character Marcus Daly has what job?
questions.fact: Hemmings had starred in Antonioni's Blow-Up nine years earlier.

questions.question: In Inferno, which of the Three Mothers rules from New York?
questions.fact: Mater Tenebrarum is the Mother of Darkness.

questions.question: In Argento's Opera, what does the killer tape beneath Betty's eyes?
questions.fact: If she blinks, the needles pierce her eyelids.

questions.question: In Tenebre, Peter Neal is an American visiting Rome for what reason?
questions.fact: The killer is copying murders from Neal's book.

questions.question: What is hammered onto the witch Asa's face at the start of Black Sunday?
questions.fact: Barbara Steele became a horror icon from this Mario Bava film.

questions.question: A double impalement in Friday the 13th Part 2 was lifted from which Mario Bava film?
questions.fact: It's often called the blueprint for the American body-count slasher.

questions.question: Bava's Blood and Black Lace is set mostly in what kind of place?
questions.fact: Its faceless, gloved killer became a giallo template.

questions.question: A priest's suicide opens a gate of hell in which town in Fulci's City of the Living Dead?
questions.fact: Dunwich is a Lovecraft reference.

questions.question: Who lurks in the basement in Fulci's The House by the Cemetery?
questions.fact: He survives by replacing his rotting body with victims' parts.

questions.question: What strange voice does the killer use in Fulci's The New York Ripper?
questions.fact: It was banned in the UK for decades.

questions.question: Lamberto Bava's Demons is set mostly inside what?
questions.fact: The demons spill out of a horror film playing at the Metropol.

questions.question: Who plays the cemetery caretaker Francesco Dellamorte in Cemetery Man?
questions.fact: The look of the character was based on Everett himself in the Dylan Dog comics.

questions.question: Who directed the Japanese cyberpunk nightmare Tetsuo: The Iron Man?
questions.fact: Tsukamoto also plays the Metal Fetishist.

questions.question: How is Pinhead credited in the original Hellraiser?
questions.fact: The "Pinhead" nickname came from the crew.

questions.question: What is the name of the god of Hell, shaped like a giant rotating diamond, in Hellbound: Hellraiser II?
questions.fact: It's the shape of the Lament Configuration's final form.

questions.question: Which horror director plays the killer psychiatrist Dr. Decker in Nightbreed?
questions.fact: The monsters hide in an underground city called Midian.

questions.question: Which composer wrote Candyman's haunting choral score?
questions.fact: Glass reportedly disliked how the final film turned out.

questions.question: What is Dr. Raglan's controversial therapy called in The Brood?
questions.fact: Patients turn their rage into physical growths.

questions.question: Who plays the villain Darryl Revok in Scanners?
questions.fact: The exploding head was done by shooting a latex head full of food scraps.

questions.question: Parasites spread through an apartment building in Cronenberg's Shivers. What is the building called?
questions.fact: It was Cronenberg's first commercial feature.

questions.question: Which adult-film star led Cronenberg's Rabid?
questions.fact: Cronenberg's first choice was Sissy Spacek.

questions.question: What is the name of Max Renn's sleazy TV station in Videodrome?
questions.fact: It's Channel 83 in Toronto.

questions.question: Which novelty company makes the deadly masks in Halloween III: Season of the Witch?
questions.film: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
questions.fact: It's the only Halloween film without Michael Myers.

questions.question: Who composed the score for John Carpenter's The Thing?
questions.fact: The main theme sounds so much like Carpenter that many fans assume he wrote it.

questions.question: Which pseudonym did John Carpenter use to write Prince of Darkness?
questions.fact: It honors Nigel Kneale's Professor Quatermass.

questions.question: What was the name of the ghost ship whose crew returns in The Fog?
questions.fact: Many character names reference Carpenter's friends and collaborators.

questions.question: In Tobe Hooper's Lifeforce, the space vampires are found hidden near which comet?
questions.fact: It was released a year before Halley's actual 1986 return.

questions.question: Who does Dennis Hopper play in The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2?
questions.fact: Lefty fights Leatherface with three chainsaws.

questions.question: The farmhouse from The Texas Chain Saw Massacre was moved and became what?
questions.fact: It's now the Grand Central Café in Kingsland, Texas.

questions.question: In Tobe Hooper's Eaten Alive, what does the hotel owner feed his victims to?
questions.fact: Robert Englund's character here has a line Tarantino later quoted in Kill Bill.

questions.question: Who is the main character possessed by Freddy in A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge?
questions.film: A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
questions.fact: Star Mark Patton later made the documentary Scream, Queen!

questions.question: Jason gets his hockey mask in Friday the 13th Part III. Who owned it?
options: A hockey player on a bus
questions.fact: Part III was released in 3-D.

questions.question: Joe Spinell's killer Frank Zito decorates his apartment with what in Maniac?
questions.fact: Tom Savini did the effects and also plays a victim.

questions.question: What town hosts the ill-fated dance in My Bloody Valentine?
questions.fact: The mining killer is Harry Warden.

questions.question: What is the chainsaw killer in Pieces trying to assemble?
questions.fact: Its poster tagline was "It's exactly what you think it is!"

questions.question: Where are the night-shift workers stalked in Intruder?
questions.fact: Sam and Ted Raimi both make cameos.

questions.question: Linda Blair spends a fraternity hazing night in which mansion in Hell Night?
questions.fact: The Garth family patriarch murdered his deformed children there.

questions.question: Which famous magician plays a performer aboard the Terror Train?
questions.fact: Jamie Lee Curtis also stars.

questions.question: In Tobe Hooper's The Funhouse, the deformed killer hides his face behind what?
questions.fact: He is the son of the carnival barker.

questions.question: Which TV Western star plays the telekinetic Mr. Slausen in Tourist Trap?
questions.fact: The mannequins are moved by Slausen's mind.

questions.question: What is the name of the ventriloquist's dummy in the 1945 anthology Dead of Night?
questions.fact: Michael Redgrave plays the ventriloquist Maxwell Frere.

questions.question: Who wrote the screenplay for The Wicker Man?
questions.fact: Shaffer also wrote the play Sleuth.

questions.question: Vincent Price plays which real-life 1640s witch hunter in Witchfinder General?
questions.fact: Director Michael Reeves died the year after its release, aged 25.

questions.question: In Theatre of Blood, Vincent Price's ham actor kills critics using what?
questions.fact: His character is Edward Lionheart.

questions.question: Dr. Phibes models his murders on what?
questions.fact: Phibes plays a giant pipe organ between killings.

questions.question: William Castle's "Emergo" gimmick for House on Haunted Hill involved what?
options: A skeleton flying over the audience
questions.fact: Kids reportedly threw popcorn and candy at the skeleton.

questions.question: William Castle's "Percepto" gimmick for The Tingler did what?
questions.fact: Vincent Price urges the audience to scream for their lives.

questions.question: Audiences supposedly voted on the villain's fate in Mr. Sardonicus. What was this gimmick called?
questions.fact: It's widely believed only the "no mercy" ending was ever filmed.

questions.question: What degenerative condition afflicts the family in Spider Baby?
questions.fact: Lon Chaney Jr. sings the theme song.

questions.question: In H.G. Lewis's Blood Feast, Fuad Ramses prepares a feast for which goddess?
questions.fact: It's often called the first gore film.

questions.question: Who directed Eyes Without a Face?
questions.fact: Billy Idol named a hit song after it.

questions.question: Who directed the 1922 witchcraft documentary-horror Häxan?
questions.fact: Christensen plays the Devil himself.

questions.question: Which Danish director made the dreamlike 1932 horror Vampyr?
questions.fact: Its lead actor was a financier who funded the film.

questions.question: Universal's Spanish-language Dracula (1931) was shot how?
options: Two years later as a remake
At night on the same sets as the Lugosi version
In Mexico City with new sets
questions.fact: Many critics prefer its camerawork to the English version.

questions.question: Kate Bush sampled the line "It's in the trees! It's coming!" from which film?
questions.fact: It opens her song "Hounds of Love."

questions.question: In which declining Pennsylvania steel town does George Romero's Martin take place?
questions.fact: Romero said it was his favorite of his films.

questions.question: Who plays the farmer Jordy Verrill, who gets overgrown by meteor moss in Creepshow?
questions.fact: King's son Joe plays the comic-loving boy Billy.

questions.question: Tom Savini plays which biker in Dawn of the Dead?
questions.fact: He also did the film's makeup effects.

questions.question: In Peter Jackson's Bad Taste, why are aliens harvesting humans?
questions.fact: The chain is called Crumb's Crunchy Delights.

questions.question: How does Tom Atkins' detective answer the phone in Night of the Creeps?
questions.fact: Many characters are named after horror directors.

questions.question: "Send more paramedics" is said into a radio in which film?
options: The Return of the Living Dead
questions.film: The Return of the Living Dead
questions.fact: The zombie had just eaten the first crew.

questions.question: Who directed the werewolf fairy tale The Company of Wolves?
questions.fact: Angela Carter co-wrote it from her own stories.

questions.question: What is the killer robot called in Richard Stanley's Hardware?
questions.fact: The name comes from a Bible verse: Mark 13.

questions.question: What device grants eternal life in Guillermo del Toro's Cronos?
questions.fact: It was del Toro's feature debut.

questions.question: What sits unexploded in the orphanage courtyard in The Devil's Backbone?
questions.fact: It's set during the Spanish Civil War.

questions.question: In Kiyoshi Kurosawa's Pulse (Kairo), how are the "forbidden rooms" sealed?
questions.fact: The ghosts spread through the internet.

questions.question: In Kurosawa's Cure, what is carved into each victim?
questions.fact: The killers are hypnotized strangers.

questions.question: In Kwaidan, what part of Hoichi do the monks forget to cover with protective sutras?
questions.fact: The ghosts can see only the ears and tear them off.

questions.question: Who directed Onibaba, with its terrifying demon mask?
questions.fact: It's set in the tall reeds of war-torn medieval Japan.

questions.question: In Ishiro Honda's Matango, castaways slowly turn into what?
questions.fact: Honda also directed the original Godzilla.

questions.question: Who directed the Korean ghost story A Tale of Two Sisters?
questions.fact: It's based on a Joseon-era folk tale.

questions.question: What is the stranger's main weapon against the pregnant Sarah in Inside (À l'intérieur)?
questions.fact: It's a key film of the New French Extremity.

questions.question: Who wrote and directed Martyrs?
questions.fact: Laugier later made The Tall Man and Incident in a Ghostland.

questions.question: Let the Right One In takes place in which Stockholm suburb?
questions.fact: Author John Ajvide Lindqvist grew up there.

questions.question: Which country produced Rare Exports, the dark Santa Claus origin story?
questions.fact: Santa is dug out of a mountain at the Russian border.

questions.question: Lake Mungo is a mockumentary about the drowning of which teenager?
questions.fact: It's an Australian film.

questions.question: What terrorizes the Australian outback in Razorback?
questions.fact: Director Russell Mulcahy later made Highlander.

questions.question: How does the virus spread in Pontypool?
options: Through words in the English language
questions.fact: Most of it takes place in a small-town radio station.

questions.question: In Session 9, which personality on Mary Hobbes' therapy tapes is revealed last?
questions.fact: "I live in the weak and the wounded."

questions.question: What is the name of May's beloved doll, kept in a glass case?
questions.fact: Lucky McKee wrote and directed.

questions.question: In The Loved Ones, which girl takes revenge on Brent after he turns down her prom invitation?
questions.fact: Her father calls her Princess.

questions.question: In which seaside town do tourists keep dying in Dead & Buried?
questions.fact: Dan O'Bannon co-wrote the screenplay.

questions.question: What do Randy Quaid's suburban parents serve every night in Parents?
questions.fact: It was the directing debut of actor Bob Balaban.

questions.question: What is the young hero's nickname in The People Under the Stairs?
questions.fact: The villainous couple are known as "Mommy and Daddy."

questions.question: In The Gate, the boys learn how to summon demons from an album by which fictional metal band?
questions.fact: It was a young Stephen Dorff's film debut.

questions.question: What does C.H.U.D. stand for, at least officially?
questions.fact: Late in the film it's revealed to mean something else too.

questions.question: How is the opening character credited in E. Elias Merhige's Begotten?
questions.fact: It led to Merhige directing Shadow of the Vampire.

questions.question: Who directed the surreal circus horror Santa Sangre?
questions.fact: Two of Jodorowsky's sons star in it.

questions.question: What is Blacula's real name before Dracula curses him?
questions.fact: He's played by Shakespearean actor William Marshall.

questions.question: In Happy Birthday to Me, which kitchen item is the infamous murder weapon?
questions.fact: J. Lee Thompson, director of The Guns of Navarone, made it.

questions.question: Which author wrote The Slumber Party Massacre as a parody of slashers?
questions.fact: Its killer uses an enormous power drill.

questions.question: Who directed the killer-toy film Dolls?
questions.fact: It was shot in Italy back-to-back with From Beyond.

questions.question: Who plays the vicious vampire Severen in Near Dark?
questions.fact: Severen's bar scene with spurs is the film's best-known.

questions.question: Which band's "Bela Lugosi's Dead" opens The Hunger?
questions.fact: Peter Murphy sings it in a cage in a nightclub.

questions.question: Which singer plays the vampire stripper Katrina in Vamp?
questions.fact: Keith Haring painted her body for the dance.

questions.question: What is the name of Jeffrey Combs' scientist in From Beyond?
questions.fact: His machine that opens the senses is called the Resonator.

questions.question: What is the name of Kayako's ghostly son in Ju-On: The Grudge?
questions.fact: He meows like the family's dead cat.
